propositions: Test races with detached git maintenance processes spawned by receive-pack after push, which touch the object database concurrently during copytree walk, causing spurious failures when copytree encounters disappearing fanout directories or lock files.

Bare fixture repositories initialized with raw git init --bare run maintenance at git defaults (detached background processes), unlike rebar-owned stores which are pinned to foreground (gc.autoDetach=false, maintenance.autoDetach=false).

Pinning receive.autogc=false, gc.autoDetach=false, and maintenance.autoDetach=false before pushing into the fixture repository eliminates detached upkeep processes entirely, removing the race instead of narrowing the window.

A new test asserts the absence of detached maintenance children in the push's git process trace via GIT_TRACE2_EVENT, with a receive-pack positive control to prevent vacuous pass, discriminating the fix from untested assumptions.

The test's core assertion (repointed sibling origin) still catches repoint defects independently, and both mutation checks (empty pins, dropped rewrites) produce observable RED failures before restore to GREEN.
